note: Template for collect.config.json (which is LOCAL and gitignored — it names the real photo sources, and source names never go public per the FAZ D red lines). Copy this file to collect.config.json and fill in your sources. Only public product-listing JSON APIs; the collector checks robots.txt, waits 1.5-3s between all requests, and skips a source on any error.

sources.brand: <local nickname, becomes dataset/<brand>/ dir + manifest field>
sources.itemsPath: result.items — dotted path to the item array in the listing JSON

extract.imageMapPath: images.main — for firstImageOfMap: object of variants, first one taken
extract.imageArrayPath: images — for firstOfArray: array of images, first one taken (e.g. Shopify products.json), query string stripped
extract.imageField: image — the URL field (on the variant/array element, or on the item itself)

categories.query: any keys here fill {placeholders} in listUrlTemplate
